say:0:1830305001:1.text: This is a blueprint for the Soul Forge. It is covered with numerous revisions and notes, with every component and material clearly laid out.
say:0:1830305001:1.source_cn: 这是一张亡灵转换器的设计图纸，有着多处反复涂改和补充标...

say:1:1830305002:1.text: Beneath it are over a hundred records documenting the Soul Forge's development process. Their cold, detached words describe one inhumane experiment after another.
say:1:1830305002:1.source_cn: 在设计图的下方还有其完善进程的相关记录，足足有一百多条...
